content.text: You’ve written your ebook. You’ve designed the cover. You’re ready to sell. But in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal aren’t options. Conventional platforms reject you. Your audience can’t pay. Your work stays on your hard drive. This isn’t a payment problem. It’s an infrastructure problem. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-architecture-actually-6|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]] solves it. We deploy sovereign commerce stacks that run on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and blockchain payments. No platforms. No subscriptions. No geographic restrictions. Your store. Your rules. Your revenue. This guide walks you through deploying your own ebook store using the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-solana-payments-digital-products-serious-2|The Complete]]-deep-dive-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments|complete]] Builder Kit. By the end, you’ll own a fully operational digital commerce stack that processes crypto payments, delivers files instantly, and stores your data securely — all without relying on any third-party platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they’re centralized. They depend on banks, governments, and payment processors that exclude entire regions. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is decentralized. It runs on GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. No single entity can shut it down. Your store operates on infrastructure you own. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers are free and globally distributed. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. Your customers pay in USDT, USDC, or SOL. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the ebook delivers automatically. This stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Nigeria. It works where platforms fail. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in regions locked out of conventional systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your assets. You need your ebook file (PDF, EPUB, or MOBI), a cover image, and a product description. Decide your price in USD, then convert it to USDT or USDC for stable pricing. Create a NOWPayments account — it’s free and takes five minutes. Choose Binance Smart Chain (BSC) or Solana for low transaction fees (under $0.10 per payment). Set up a Cloudflare account for Workers and R2 storage. If you prefer Google’s ecosystem, use Google Drive for file delivery and Google Sheets for order tracking. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for both setups. You’ll also need a domain name — optional but recommended for professionalism. All these tools are free or low-cost. You’re not renting infrastructure. You’re building it.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payment processing. In your NOWPayments dashboard, create a payment link for your ebook. Set the price in USDT or USDC. Copy the webhook URL — this triggers file delivery when payment confirms. Deploy your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built scripts. Paste your NOWPayments API key and webhook URL into the script. Configure file delivery. Upload your ebook to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. The script generates a temporary download link when payment is verified. Test the pipeline. Send a test payment. Ensure the ebook delivers instantly. If using Google Sheets, the order details log automatically. If using Supabase, the database updates in real time. Your pipeline is now live and fully automated.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own. No platforms. No subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally fast. The Complete Builder Kit includes HTML/CSS templates for your product page. Customize the template with your ebook’s title, description, and price. Embed the NOWPayments button or use a direct payment link. Publish your site. Share the link with your audience. Monitor your NOWPayments dashboard for transactions. The first payment will trigger the webhook, deliver the ebook, and log the order. Your customer receives the file instantly. You receive payment directly to your crypto wallet. No intermediaries. No delays. Your store is now operational. You’re selling ebooks on your own infrastructure.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your store is live. Now scale it. Add more products by duplicating the pipeline. Each ebook gets its own payment link and delivery script. Use the Complete Builder Kit’s scaling playbook to automate this process. Optimize for performance. Cloudflare Workers handle thousands of requests per second. Upgrade to Cloudflare’s paid tier if your traffic grows. For analytics, integrate Google Sheets or Supabase with your dashboard. Track sales, revenue, and customer locations. Expand your payment options. Add BTC, ETH, or SOL to your NOWPayments account. Offer customers more choices. Your infrastructure is modular. Add or remove components as needed. You’re not locked into any platform. You’re building a commerce stack that grows with your business.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

To sell ebooks from Kenya without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Upload your ebook to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for instant delivery. Use the Complete Builder Kit for pre-built templates and scripts. Test the pipeline with a test payment, then go live. Your store processes payments directly to your crypto wallet and delivers files automatically — no intermediaries required.
Blockchain payments remove geographic barriers. Sell to anyone, anywhere.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your ebook file, cover image, and product description. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and set your price in USDT or USDC. 3. Set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. 4. Upload your ebook to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 5. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 6. Test the payment and delivery pipeline with a test transaction. 7. Share your store link and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates and scripts. Follow the step-by-step guide to deploy your store without writing code from scratch.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. We recommend USDT, USDC, or SOL for low fees and stable pricing.
How much does it cost to deploy this stack?
GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Google Sheets are free. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. The Complete Builder Kit is a one-time purchase of $197.
Can I sell multiple products with this setup?
Yes. Duplicate the payment and delivery pipeline for each product. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to automate this process.
What happens if a payment fails?
The ebook won’t deliver until payment confirms on-chain. Customers can retry the payment. The system is fully automated and requires no manual intervention.
